meta.title: Strength & Conditioning 2027
meta.subtitle: Bench 315 (= 225×12) · back-safe leg power · −20 lb to 175–180 · FTP + VO2max up · daily core
meta.race_date_note: Saturday before Labor Day — confirm when the 2027 date is posted

goals.label: Bench e1RM
goals.note: 225×12 and 315×1 are the same e1RM — one goal, two tests

goals.label: Body mass
goals.note: cut Sep 21 → Apr 15 at 0.5–0.75 lb/wk, then hold

goals.label: FTP
goals.note: ≈3.3 W/kg at 178 lb; the sub-10 lever

goals.label: Core sessions / week
goals.note: McGill Big 3 near-daily + 2 gym core blocks

phases.name: Transition
phases.gym: 3×/wk light, 3×8–12, RPE ≤7 — tendons and patterns, not loads
phases.bike: Post-race recovery → easy Z2; October cool sea-level retest
phases.weight: Start a gentle deficit (−250 kcal) in week 2
phases.bench_rule: 3×8–10, +5 lb/week, RPE ≤7, 1-count pause on the chest

phases.name: Strength + Base
phases.gym: 3×/wk (Upper A · Lower · Upper B), linear progression — THE strength phase
phases.bike: Z2 backbone 7–9 h; one 4×4 VO2/wk from November; one sweet-spot ride/wk
phases.bench_rule: Mon 3×5 +5 lb/session while all 15 reps are clean; Fri 4×6–8 at −10–15%; stall twice → −10% and rebuild

phases.name: Build
phases.gym: 2×/wk (Upper · Lower), wave loading, intensity up / volume down; power work starts
phases.bench_rule: 5/3/1-style waves off a training max = 90% e1RM; top set AMRAP logged with +

phases.name: Specific
phases.gym: 2×/wk strength maintenance + power (swings, jumps, sled); 225×12 test in June
phases.bike: Long climbs, altitude weeks, Testa PC menu incl. 50–60 rpm torque grinds
phases.weight: Hold 175–180, no deficit, carbs periodized to ride days
phases.bench_rule: Singles/doubles at 85–92%, low volume; 225 rep test in June

phases.name: Peak / Taper
phases.gym: 1×/wk full body; 315 attempt Aug 1–14 only if e1RM tracking ≥325 (else October)
phases.bike: Race prep as 2026; front-3-hours restraint is the stated lesson
phases.bench_rule: 2×2 @ 90%; attempt window Aug 1–14 if on track

items: Core: Hanging knee raise 3×10–15 · Pallof press 3×10/side · Dead bug 3×8/side
Core: Suitcase carry 2×40 m · Side plank 3×30s/side
Z2 1.5–2.5 h, fueled (gut training per Kary)
Core: Hanging knee raise 3×10–20 · Pallof press 3×10/side · Dead bug 3×8/side
Trap-bar deadlift 4×6 (+10 lb/wk when clean, RPE cap 8)
4 × 4 min, HR 175–184 by end of min 2 (~270–290 W), 3 min easy between · ride it fresh · sweet-spot 2×20 in early P1 instead
Core: Suitcase carry 2×40 m · Side plank 3×30s/side
Bench press wave (5s / 3s / 1+ / deload) off TM = 90% e1RM
VO2 block: 4×4 or Rønnestad 30/15 · Threshold block: Z2
Bench press 3×3 @ 85–90% (225 rep test in June)
Threshold / climbing per Testa PC menu
Z2 60–90 min or torque grinds 5×4 @ 50–60 rpm
Bench press 2×2 @ 90% (315 attempt Aug 1–14 if on track)
Curl-up · Side plank · Bird dog (5-3-1) — only this in race week

rules: Bike wins (Testa): if 24 h soreness stops you holding a 130 W Z2 floor, drop gym loads 20%.
Lift after Z2 rides, never before intervals; heavy lower ≥48 h before the long ride.
Spine: neutral on every hinge; RPE cap 8 on trap-bar and RDL; no grinding reps; no max-outs on hinges; stop at the first back tightness and swap to leg press / split squat. No barbell back squat.
Trips: Hotel Upper / Hotel Lower / Hotel Core count fully toward the week.
Sleep <6 h two nights running → that day's gym session becomes Big 3 + walk.
Deload every 4th week: strength sets −40%, loads held, aligned with the bike recovery week.

items: Dumbbell bench press or Floor press 4×8
Pallof press with a packed band 3×10/side
